data.name: Line arithmetic
data.condition: Every invoice line
data.check: extended_amount = quantity × unit_price

data.name: Workday vs POMS value match
data.condition: Invoice references a POMS order (Sales Order = Order No)
data.check: Order exists in POMS and Total Invoice Amount matches the POMS amount within a 0.05 tolerance: Grand Total Price by default; Final Payment Amount for Payment Receipt; for Sales Invoice / Sales Invoice Bank, Grand Total Price minus the first positive of Final Payment Amount / Upfront Payment is accepted as a fallback. Skipped for delivery notes and credit notes, and superseded by NO21-004 once an NGA tracker response exists
data.source: POMS order (mappings.yaml: Total Invoice Amount ↔ Grand Total Price)

data.name: Invoice type vs POMS order state
data.condition: Workday Invoice Type is one of the mapped types (Early Invoice, Sales Invoice, Sales Invoice Bank, Sales Invoice FSP, Sales Invoice Fleet, Fleet / FSP / Bank Invoice Before Handover, Payment Receipt)
data.check: POMS Type, Order Status, Financing Option and Lock State are all in the allowed list for that invoice type (mappings.yaml invoice_type_rule)

data.name: Customer vs POMS owner
data.condition: Invoice references a POMS order
data.check: Workday Customer fuzzy-matches POMS Owner (token ratio ≥ 85)

data.name: Company vs POMS market
data.condition: Invoice references a POMS order
data.check: Workday Company country prefix equals the POMS Market code (SE21 ↔ SE, NL-BE style codes accepted)

data.name: Currency
data.condition: Invoice references a POMS order
data.check: Workday invoice currency equals POMS order currency

data.name: VIN match
data.condition: Invoice references a POMS order
data.check: Invoice VIN equals POMS VIN

data.name: Related party revenue category
data.condition: Bill-To or Sold-To is a related-party financing bank (customer.related_party = true) AND line description contains 'Brand'
data.check: Line revenue_category = 3030
data.remediation: Manually correct the revenue category to 3030.

data.name: NGA tracker captured
data.condition: Bill-To customer.nga_customer = true
data.check: A tracker row exists for the invoice with invoice_number, customer_id, model_number, total_invoice_price, gross_taxable_amount and base_price populated

data.name: NGA response received
data.condition: NGA customer with a tracker row
data.check: tracker.response_status = RESPONDED

data.name: Fee lines removed when instructed
data.condition: tracker.remove_fees = true
data.check: No line whose revenue category is a fee category (3041, 3042, 3043)

data.name: Revised gross and base applied
data.condition: NGA tracker responded
data.check: Invoice taxable amount = revised_gross_amount; vehicle line unit price = revised_base_price

data.name: VAT recalculated after amendment
data.condition: Every NO21 invoice
data.check: tax_amount = taxable_amount × 25%

data.name: Factoring payment captured
data.condition: A payment is applied to the invoice as ON_ACCOUNT
data.check: payment_id exists in the factoring tracker

data.name: Leasing licence plate
data.condition: Bill-To is a leasing company that requires the licence plate (customer.leasing_plate_required = true)
data.check: Vehicle line description contains the POMS license_plate

data.name: Personal loan bill-to
data.condition: POMS financing_type = PERSONAL_LOAN and the partner is not flagged bank_sold_to_exception
data.check: Bill-To = Sold-To = buyer

data.name: Bank sold-to exception
data.condition: POMS financing partner is flagged bank_sold_to_exception
data.check: Bill-To = Sold-To = the loan provider

data.name: VAT number on extras / prepayment
data.condition: document_kind is Sales Invoice Extra or prepayment
data.check: customer_vat_number populated (fallback source: Salesforce)

data.name: E&Y final invoice match
data.condition: An E&Y final invoice exists for the Workday invoice
data.check: invoice_date, customer name, PO number, VIN, amount excl. VAT and total all equal

data.name: Gapless numbering and approval order
data.condition: Statutory invoice types PRT Invoice / Credit note - EY
data.check: Workday statutory number equals the E&Y number; an APPROVED invoice must have an E&Y final invoice

data.name: Exclude internal zero-value documents
data.condition: Delivery Note or Sales Invoice Extra with zero value
data.check: Flag as excluded from the daily E&Y report

data.name: SharePoint tracker adjustments applied
data.condition: Bill-To customer.sharepoint_tracker = true and a tracker row exists for the POMS order
data.check: po_number = required_po_reference; vehicle unit price = agreed_unit_price; description contains required_description_text

data.name: VAT rate agrees with POMS
data.condition: Invoice references a POMS order
data.check: Workday tax rate / tax amount equals the VAT rate and VAT amount on the POMS order
data.remediation: Change the tax code to the POMS VAT rate and recalculate tax.

data.name: PO number present
data.condition: B2B customer invoice
data.check: po_number is populated (DE21 B2B customers require the PO / order reference on the invoice)
data.remediation: Populate the PO number from the POMS order.

data.name: Sold-To matches POMS buyer
data.condition: Invoice references a POMS order
data.check: sold_to_customer equals the ordering company in POMS
data.remediation: Correct Sold-To (and Bill-To) to the POMS buyer.

data.name: Model / model year matches POMS
data.condition: Invoice references a POMS order
data.check: Invoice model incl. model year equals the ordered car
data.remediation: Correct the model worktag and vehicle line description.

data.name: POMS order invoiced
data.condition: Every non-cancelled POMS order past handover planning
data.check: At least one Workday invoice references the order (reported at run level, not per invoice)
